content.what_it_is: Preprocessed (build/pre) Fortran source of the FUNWAVE-TVD main program (VERSION 3.0 per L58). Header comments document the call plan (L60-79), the open file units ((1) input, (2) output, (3) log, (4) hotstart, L81-82) and the intended hot-start data layout (dimensions, time, physics, numerics, wet-dry, depth, variables, wavemaker; L84-145; note L138 says Cm/Sm data too large so WK_IRR recalculates on hotstart). Program FUNWAVE_TVD (L56-339): USE GLOBAL/TIDE_MODULE/TIME_SPECTRA_MODULE (L147,L152-153); MPI_INIT (L160); READ_INPUT (L163); TIME=HotStartTime when INI_UVZ (ykchoi 14.12.24, L167-170); INDEX (L172); ALLOCATE_VARIABLES (L176); INITIALIZATION (L179); TIME_SPECTRA_INITIAL when WaveMaker=='TIME_SPECTRA' (L183-185); TIDE_INITIAL (L187); TIME_SPECTRA_PROTECTION (L189-192, comment: time spectra only use tide abs_gen and tide data type). Time loop DO WHILE(TIME<TOTAL_TIME) (L209-320): wall time via MPI_Wtime (L206); CALL OUTPUT first to capture the initial condition (comment 11/27/2018, L211-213); SOLITARY_WAVE_LEFT_BOUNDARY for LEF_SOL (L215-217); save previous-level Eta0=Eta, Ubar0=Ubar, Vbar0=Vbar (L220-222); EXCHANGE (L228); ESTIMATE_DT(Mloc,Nloc,DX,DY,U,V,H,MinDepthFrc,DT,CFL,TIME) (L232); U0=U, V0=V moved before the RK loop for Ut,Vt computation (ykchoi 15.08.06, L235-237); TIDE_DATA when TideBcType=='DATA' (L242-244); TIME_SPECTRA_INTERPOLATION (L247-249); 3rd-order Runge-Kutta stage loop DO ISTAGE=1,3 (L255-302) calling per stage: Cal_Dispersion if DISPERSION (L257-259), FLUXES (L262), SourceTerms (after fluxes to get eta_t, comment L265), ESTIMATE_HUV(ISTAGE) (L268), UPDATE_MASK (moved inside RK, comment L270-271), TIDE_BC if TIDAL_BC_ABS (L273-275), WAVE_BREAKING (L279), EXCHANGE (L283), ABSORBING_GENERATING_BC for ABS/TIME_SPECTRA (L288-292), IRREGULAR_LEFT_BC for LEFT_BC_IRR (L294-296), SPONGE_DAMPING if DIRECT_SPONGE (L298-300); after the stage loop MIXING_STUFF (L305), MAX_MIN_PROPERTY when any of OUT_Hmax/Hmin/Umax/MFmax/VORmax/Time (L312-314), CHECK_BLOWUP (L316). After the loop: final STATIONS flush when NumberStations>0 (L322-324), wall-time report 'Simulation takes ... seconds' to screen and unit 3 (L330-335), 'Normal Termination!' (L334-335), MPI_FINALIZE (L337). Lines 342-406 are a pure comment glossary of variable definitions (Depth/DepthNode/DepthX/DepthY, Eta/Eta0, MASK/MASK_STRUC/MASK9, U/V as depth-averaged or reference-level u_alpha, HU/HV, P/Q as HU/HV+dispersion at interfaces, Fx..Gy, Ubar/Vbar, U1p/V1p, interface L/R values EtaRxL..HyR, HUxL..HUyR, PL..QR) including the flux formulas FxL=HUxL*UxL+1/2*g*(EtaRxL^2+2*EtaRxL*Depthx) (L399-400), FyL=HyL*UyL*VyL (L401-402), GxL=HxL*UxL*VxL (L403-404), GyL=HVyL*VyL+1/2*g*(EtaRyL^2+2*EtaRyL*Depthy) (L405-406).
entities: (comment) ISTAGE moved to mod_global 09/12/2017 @L157; tbegin,tend moved to mod_global 07/29/2016 @L158

verbatim_spans.text: !     move output here to get the initial condition 11/27/2018
CALL SourceTerms   ! put sourceterms after fluxes in order to get eta_t

unresolved: All working variables (TIME, TOTAL_TIME, Eta, Ubar, U0, ISTAGE, tbegin/tend, TIDAL_BC_ABS, TideBcType etc.) come from GLOBAL/TIDE_MODULE/TIME_SPECTRA_MODULE — cross-file; ISTAGE and tbegin/tend were moved to mod_global per comments L157-158
the hot-start data layout documented at L84-145 (units, fields, 'need to confirm if the saved data is consistent with input.txt' L91) describes functionality whose read/write code is not in this file
the header call plan (L60-79) lists 'FLUXES / SourceTerms again' after EXCHANGE but the actual stage loop calls each once per stage — the comment reflects an older structure

every subroutine called (INDEX, EXCHANGE, ESTIMATE_DT, SourceTerms, UPDATE_MASK, MIXING_STUFF, MAX_MIN_PROPERTY, CHECK_BLOWUP, ABSORBING_GENERATING_BC, IRREGULAR_LEFT_BC, SPONGE_DAMPING, SOLITARY_WAVE_LEFT_BOUNDARY, TIDE_*, TIME_SPECTRA_*) is defined in other files (cross-file)
